description: Two clock-synced envelope generators, each given a tempo by tapping or pinging and running at a division or multiple of it

params.text: Tap it twice to set that side's time; the envelope then runs from the time between the taps
Sets that side's envelope cycling, so it starts again as soon as it finishes
Sets that side's period against the pinged time, in fifteen steps from an eighth of it up to eight times it
Sets the height of that side's ENV output
Moves the peak of that side's envelope from the start of its period to the end
Bends the slopes of that side's envelope between exponential, linear and logarithmic
Switches that side's ENV output between a swing from 0V upward and one centred on 0V

inputs.text: Two edges above 2V set that side's time, and the envelope then runs from the time between them
A rising edge above 2V fires that side's envelope in step with the pinged clock
An edge above 2V switches cycling on both sides at once
A rising edge above 2V fires that side's envelope at once, out of step with the clock; whether a held gate sustains it is chosen on the menu
Adds to that side's PING DIV/MULT knob, 10V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to that side's SKEW knob, 10V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to that side's CURVE knob, 10V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits

outputs.text: That side's envelope after the SCALE knob and the bi-polar button, running between -10V and +10V
That side's envelope at a fixed 0V to 5V, with SCALE and the bi-polar button passing it by
A 5V gate or pulse at the end of the rise or halfway up it, whichever the menu is set to
A 5V gate or pulse at the end of the fall, or at the tapped tempo, whichever the menu is set to
Whichever of the two ENV outputs is the higher at each moment
A 5V gate or pulse halfway up the rise or at the end of it, whichever the menu is set to

notes: Each side counts its voices from the widest of its own ping, QNT and async jacks, up to four.
menu: Async Red Mode: ASR, AR — sets what a gate on the red async jack does: ASR holds the envelope up while the gate is high, AR fires a rise and fall regardless
Async Blue Mode: ASR, AR — sets what a gate on the blue async jack does: ASR holds the envelope up while the gate is high, AR fires a rise and fall regardless
Free-Running Ping Red — when off, the red envelope stops after the last ping instead of running on
Free-Running Ping Blue — when off, the blue envelope stops after the last ping instead of running on
Skew Limit Red — holds the red side's skew back from the extremes that leave one slope too short to hear
Skew Limit Blue — holds the blue side's skew back from the extremes that leave one slope too short to hear
EOF Red Mode: EOF Gate, EOF Trig, Tap Tempo Gate, Tap Tempo Trig — chooses what the red side's EOF jack marks and whether it is a gate or a pulse
EOF Blue Mode: EOF Gate, EOF Trig, Tap Tempo Gate, Tap Tempo Trig — chooses what the blue side's EOF jack marks and whether it is a gate or a pulse
EOR Red Mode: EOR Gate, EOR Trig, Half-Rise Gate, Half-Rise Trig — chooses what the red side's EOR jack marks and whether it is a gate or a pulse
Half-R Blue Mode: Half-Rise Gate, Half-Rise Trig, EOR Gate, EOR Trig — chooses what the blue side's HALF-R jack marks and whether it is a gate or a pulse
